rows.label: bf06240100_0010
rows.name:
We have been waiting for
you, Your Highness.

rows.label: bf06240100_0020
rows.name:
Yeah, it's been a while.
Is the old man inside?

rows.label: bf06240100_0030
rows.name:
Indeed. He has been eagerly
awaiting your return.

rows.label: bf06240100_0040
rows.name: Idiot! As if that would happen!

rows.label: bf06240100_0050
rows.name:
If that were true the world
would be turned upside down.

rows.label: bf06240100_0080
rows.name:
Looks like he knows what's going on here.
That'll make things easier.

rows.label: bf06240100_0145
rows.name:
It's true Hana can generate her own
ether energy, but...

rows.label: bf06240100_0150
rows.name: Sorry. For now, it'd help if you did as I say.

rows.label: bf06240100_0160
rows.name: Got it, mo. Leave it to Tora, mo.
